essence: An oblation with excellent fuel sticks removes all death and disease
An apamarga fuel-stick oblation destroys all ailments
The thirty-six-syllabled Dakshinamurti mantra is enclosed by om and hrim
Obeisance is offered to Rudra-Shambhu who is devoted solely to meditation
The deity Dakshinamurti is the imperishable origin of the worlds
